collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE V: FAMILY DRAMA, FEUDS AND LEADERSHIP DISPUTES (LCE-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
All sorts of real-life drama suited to Isola: parents with opinions about who their children marry, arranged matches, inheritances, feuds between families, accusations, apologies that are not enough, and arguments about who should lead.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager feels their parent always favored their sibling: say so, or let it rest.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Growing up, (subject) always felt that (subject.his/her) mother loved (friend) best: more praise, more attention, the best piece of fish. Now they are grown, and (subject) has finally said it out loud, to (friend), who is shocked. (friend) never noticed. What should they do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: They go to their mother together. She is upset, and says she loved them equally. Then, slowly, she admits that (friend) was the easier child, and she may have shown it. She is sorry. (subject) does not feel healed. (subject.He/she) feels heard. That is something.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) decides there is no point now. (friend) is quiet for a long time. Then (friend.he/she) starts saving the best piece of fish for (subject) at every family meal. (subject) notices. Neither of them says anything about it.
